description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model to use for this agent. If not specified, inherits from parent. Prefer lighter models for quick, straightforward tasks to minimize cost and latency.

computer.description: Optional computer selector: 'cloud', a connected computer name, device ID, or connection ID. Use only when the task must run somewhere other than the current computer; otherwise omit it. Available for cloud/API-backed agents.

agent_id.description: Deploy an existing agent instead of creating a new one. Starts a new conversation with that agent.

conversation_id.description: Resume from an existing conversation. Does NOT require agent_id (conversation IDs are unique and encode the agent).
